page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor using x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, the server delivers 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is sized at 32.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The processor cache architecture includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Supported hardware features include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI instruction sets for enhanced crypto and vectorized calculations.

The instance operates without local attached storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Benchmark results demonstrate general mid-tier performance, recording a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 15544.16 and a Passmark CPU score of 21125.85. Memory write throughput on large uncached blocks is measured at 56.68 GB/sec. Small-model LLM text generation reaches 263.14 tokens/sec on a 135M parameter model. The resource allocation profile favors processing density over memory capacity, making the instance suited for software compilation, web serving, data transformation, and lightweight AI inference tasks.
